gateway.analise_ajuda: After migrating the fleet to a new token, anything that keeps arriving on this token is suspicious. Fraud signals: calls without identity (the raw token was used, outside the official path) and the same identity coming from several source IPs or with different sets of IPs (token copied to another machine).
gateway.analise_sub: Signs that the token was copied or used outside the official path.
gateway.cadastre_ds: Register the DeepSeek key in the API Gateway to unlock the DeepSeek options.
gateway.campos_ajuda: Each field is sent by the client in the x-ravi-<chave> header. Mark it as required for the Gateway to reject any call from this token that does not include the field filled in. The tokenravi (Ravi system token, different from the API token) and server_ips fields are already sent by compatible monitoring systems.
gateway.campos_sub: What each call from this token must include to identify the source system.
gateway.custo_estimado: Estimated cost on the official API
gateway.custo_explica: The cost is an estimate of what would be spent on the official API, calculated only on the client's actual prompt (excluding the agent's internal context, which is reused and does not exist on the official API).
gateway.deepseek_desc: Served by the DeepSeek API, requested by direct id (e.g.: deepseek-flash).
gateway.deepseek_sem: No key registered: calls will be rejected until one is registered in the API Gateway.
gateway.ds_texto: deepseek-* models through the official DeepSeek API. The key is stored encrypted and does nothing on its own: usage is enabled by each token's rule in Models.
gateway.endpoint_dica: Use the token as x-api-key, with the header anthropic-version: 2023-06-01. Accepts attachments: up to 4 images (5 MB each) and 1 PDF (10 MB) per call.
gateway.exec_texto: Who executes when this token requests a claude-* model. Switching to DeepSeek migrates the client system without changing anything in it: it keeps requesting claude and the Gateway serves the DeepSeek equivalent, recording the served model in the history. deepseek-* models requested by id go to DeepSeek, unless the "Max even on deepseek-*" rule is on, which also reverses that path.
gateway.executores_sub: who uses what is chosen per token, in Models
gateway.gpt_texto: gpt-* models on the panel's ChatGPT accounts, using the plan quota (zero cost per token). The accounts are the same as in Licenses; multiple accounts form a chain, like the Max licenses.
gateway.historico_sub: Latest calls from this token (up to 200), with source, time, call and response.
gateway.ips_servidor: Real IPs declared by the server
gateway.max_texto: Default executor for all tokens: claude-* models through the Max subscription, with the panel's license routing.
gateway.modelos_sub: Who executes this token's calls and which models it can request.
gateway.op_ds_desc: All claude-* calls from this token go to DeepSeek (haiku and sonnet become Flash; opus becomes V4 Pro).
gateway.op_ds_haiku: DeepSeek only for the Haiku family
gateway.op_ds_haiku_desc: claude-haiku becomes DeepSeek V4.1 Flash; sonnet and opus stay on Max.
gateway.op_max_desc: Everything through the Max subscription, as always.
gateway.op_max_ds_desc: The reverse: deepseek-* requests from this token are served by the Max subscription (Flash becomes Haiku; Pro becomes Sonnet), without using the DeepSeek account. The history records the original request and the served model.
gateway.openai_desc: Served by Codex on the panel's ChatGPT accounts, using the plan quota.
gateway.openai_sem: No active account: calls will be rejected until one is registered in Licenses.
gateway.passo1_texto: At your domain provider, create an A (or CNAME) record from
gateway.passo2: Publish the site and the certificate
gateway.passo2_texto: On the server, as administrator, in the installation folder. The first command generates the site configuration and shows at the end how to enable it; the second issues the certificate.
gateway.passo3_texto: Click Verify above. Then, client systems call the endpoint below with a token key:
gateway.permitidos_texto: Which models this token can request. Outside the list, the Gateway rejects with a generic error (the reason is kept only in the log). The rule matches by family: restricting claude-haiku-4-5 covers any haiku id, and the same applies to DeepSeek. With no restriction, the whole catalog is allowed.

gateway.sem_chamadas: No calls recorded for this token yet

licencas.backup_modelo_texto: If the primary model fails (no credit, down, licenses exhausted), the gateway goes through the fallbacks in order (1st, then 2nd) and logs the requested and served model in the history. With no fallback configured, the failure is returned as a clear error. Fallbacks respect each key's allowed models.
licencas.backups_texto: Backups, in order of attempt (apply after each request's primary).
licencas.backups_texto_principal: Backups, in order of attempt (apply after the primary). The primary (":nome") is always tried first, so it does not appear in the list.
licencas.copiar_falhou: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
licencas.deepseek_falta: The DeepSeek key is not registered yet (API Gateway): a DeepSeek fallback would fail until it is registered.
licencas.esgotada_dica: Reached the usage limit; the Autonomous Dev balance redirects agents until this time
licencas.excluir_texto: Delete ":nome"? Whoever was using it will be left WITHOUT a license (it stops working until you assign another).

licencas.gpt_ajuda_3: Codex stores the credential in ~/.codex/auth.json. If your machine uses the system keychain instead of the file, add the line below to ~/.codex/config.toml and sign in again:
licencas.gpt_ajuda_4: Copy the entire contents of the file and paste it into "New license":
licencas.gpt_ajuda_nota: This is the path documented by OpenAI for machines without a browser. Treat the contents like a password. Codex renews the tokens on its own roughly every 8 days, and the system stores the renewed version here; if a license stops authenticating (account signed out, password changed, token revoked), run codex login again and paste the new auth.json into "Edit".
licencas.gpt_ajuda_titulo: How to get a license credential
licencas.gpt_auth_dica: Treat the contents like a password. See "How to get the credential".
licencas.gpt_auth_novo: New auth.json (leave blank to keep the current one)
licencas.gpt_auth_ph_editar: Paste a new auth.json only if you want to replace it (e.g. after running codex login again)
licencas.gpt_excluir_texto: Delete ":nome"? The IDEs that used it will have Codex signed out.
licencas.gpt_ind_em_uso_dica: Licenses chosen as the IDE default or by a user
licencas.gpt_ind_usuarios_dica: Users with their own ChatGPT license (the others inherit the default)
licencas.gpt_padrao_texto: Which ChatGPT license Codex uses in the IDE for users without their own choice (table below). "None" leaves Codex signed out by default.
licencas.gpt_padrao_vazio: Register a license to choose the default.
licencas.gpt_por_usuario_texto: Overrides the default only for the chosen user. Each user's Claude license is on the Claude Code tab (the IDE (ChatGPT) column is also available there).
licencas.gpt_salvo_global: Default license saved. IDEs receive the change within 1 minute.
licencas.gpt_sem_ativa_texto: Per-user choice appears when there is at least one active ChatGPT license. Each user's Claude license remains on the Claude Code tab.
licencas.gpt_vazio_texto: Without a license, Codex in the IDE opens signed out (each user can sign in with their own account, if they wish).
licencas.ind_em_uso_dica: Licenses chosen by a consumer, user or routing
licencas.ind_semana_dica: Highest weekly limit usage among active licenses
licencas.ind_sessao_dica: Highest 5-hour session usage among active licenses
licencas.pool_texto: Participating licenses (minimum 2; inactive ones are not drawn even if checked):
licencas.por_consumidor_texto: Which license each consumer uses by default. There is no automatic fallback: a consumer without a defined license does not work (for security, the system never uses a license you did not choose).
licencas.por_usuario_gpt: The IDE (ChatGPT) column chooses the ChatGPT license that Codex uses in this user's IDE.
licencas.por_usuario_texto: Overrides the global default only for the chosen user. "Inherits the default" uses the scope's global license. IDE and Autonomous Dev are independent.
licencas.renovacao_dica: When this subscription renews its weekly limits (Anthropic shows the day and time in the account itself or in the limit message). Optional; if you fill it in, provide both day and time.
licencas.rot_api_balance: Two chosen licenses share the load (random draw on each request); if the drawn one fails, its partner is used. A key with its own license stays out of the balance (uses only its own).
licencas.rot_api_failover: Primary and backups in an ordered list. Tries them in order and stops at the first one that responds.
licencas.rot_api_off: Each request uses only the primary (the key's own license, or the API license).
licencas.rot_api_texto: The primary for each request is the API key's own license or, if it has none, the API license defined per consumer. The API only tries licenses chosen here: if none responds, the request fails with an error.
licencas.rot_auto_balance: Check 2 or more licenses; each new agent goes to the least used one at that moment.
licencas.rot_auto_off: All agents use the Autonomous Dev license (the user's, or the global default).
licencas.rot_auto_texto: Autonomous Dev starts several agents at once and, on a single license, the parallel waves exceed the account's session limit. With balance, each agent goes out through the least loaded license among those checked and stays on it until it finishes. A license that reaches its limit is paused until its renewal time ("Exhausted" badge) and the next agents use the others. Users with their own Autonomous Dev license stay out of the balance.
licencas.salvo: Assignment saved. Applies to anything opened from now on.
licencas.salvo_gpt_usuario: Assignment saved. The user's IDE receives the license within 1 minute.
licencas.sub_claude: Max subscriptions and which license each consumer uses: API, IDE and Autonomous Dev, with per-user choice.
licencas.sub_gpt: ChatGPT accounts (Plus, Pro, Business, Enterprise) and which one Codex uses in each user's IDE: the official Codex extension and the terminal codex command open already signed in. Changes reach open IDEs within 1 minute.
licencas.teto_campo: Usage cap for IDE and Autonomous Dev (%)
licencas.teto_campo_dica: When plan usage (5h session or week) reaches this percentage, the IDE and the Autonomous Dev stop using this license until the window resets; the remaining headroom is reserved for the API, which is never blocked by the cap. Empty = no cap.
licencas.teto_dica: Usage cap for the IDE and the Autonomous Dev: upon reaching :n% of the plan windows they pause until reset, reserving the headroom for the API
licencas.token_novo: New token (leave empty to keep the current one)
licencas.token_ph: Paste the generated token here (see "How to get the token")
licencas.uso_atualizar_dica: Queries each license at Anthropic now (the bars show the most recent stored data)
licencas.uso_fable_renovou: the window has reset since the last reading; no new usage observed
licencas.uso_no_teto: AT THE CAP of :n% (IDE and Autonomous Dev paused until reset; headroom reserved for the API)
licencas.uso_sem_fable_dica: Anthropic only reports the Fable window in responses to real Fable requests from Claude Code; this license has not handled any through the IDE yet.
licencas.uso_teto: cap for IDE and Autonomous Dev: :n%
licencas.vazio_env: No licenses yet. The system's current license will be imported automatically.
licencas.vazio_texto: Add the first one: without a license, nothing authenticates.
